clock_contract.clock: Godot Time.get_ticks_usec monotonic process wall clock, shared by Main and its worker thread; elapsed spans include waiting and are not CPU time.
clock_contract.delivery: Receipt-ready timestamp through Main result extraction, pending-identity checks and timing observation, before subsequent pose-echo processing.
clock_contract.maxima: Counter deltas of cumulative lifetime maxima are not interval maxima and are intentionally not used.
clock_contract.non_additive: Pump elapsed time includes waits and Main stages. Rapier, owner snapshots, frame copying and ordinary worker metrics can overlap the command spans; do not add them to the serial sum or infer a complete wall/CPU decomposition.
clock_contract.owner_service: Worker handler entry through native owner command and handler completion; includes authorization/dispatch and any final coupling preparation, not all ordinary semantic World work.
clock_contract.probe_percentiles: Optional recorded-stage percentiles are bounded recent probe samples after diagnostics are enabled immediately before sampling. Ordinary receipt_delivery measures snapshot-publication age, not the exact-control delivery stage. Latest worker metrics are one snapshot, not interval averages.
clock_contract.publication_copy: Handler completion through optional full owner publication, receipt/result copies and receipt-ready timestamp.
clock_contract.queue: Control admission timestamp to worker command-handler entry.
clock_contract.serial_sum: The four stages partition each observed serial control. One pending Main control at a time establishes the ordered pipeline. Reported sums are normalized by native ticks within the same finite window; a window may end with one partially completed physical interval.
